workflow.pose_profile_rule: Each per-image character profile permits exactly one pose and one expression; do not leave front, three-quarter, and profile pose choices enabled together.
workflow.generation_policy: Generate one image at a time; validate the first pilot as a single continuous photographic frame before continuing.

excluded_first_attempt.reason: Initial cream output became a three-view triptych despite single-pose wording; the per-run character profile simultaneously allowed front, three-quarter, and profile poses.
excluded_first_attempt.resolution: Constrain the per-run character profile to one requested pose and one expression; strengthen single-frame wording; rerun one cream pilot and visually inspect before the rest.

failure_review.historical_trace_scope: AIPS retained cross-workflow trace: 338 events, 303 complete and 35 blocked; p50 161727 ms, p95 444210 ms. This aggregates multiple creative runs, not only linen-shirt jobs. Frequent block reasons include comfy_job_recovery_required and mps_dtype_unsupported.
